background: Wells Fargo & Company is the holding company of one of the four largest US banks, with consumer banking and lending, commercial banking, corporate and investment banking and wealth management, and a long regulatory remediation behind it.
synthesis: Ratings are A on average across all three main agencies, but the spread is wide, with the weakest of them at BBB+, one on a positive outlook and two on a stable outlook, and the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 Jul 2021. Capital is mixed against US banks, with CET1 of 10.3% in the bottom quarter and leverage of 5.8% just above the peer median; both have fallen 0.9 points since 30 Jun 2025. Liquidity is sound, with LCR of 119% above the median. The newest flagged items, on 18 Sep 2026, are local news and job cuts, and an earlier trading outage was resolved; none of it bears materially on its credit.
